originalTitle: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
content: I turned three security cameras into an automatic bird identification system using BirdNet-Go. Now my wife and I can track every bird species that visits our yard in real-time.
chineseTitle: 我把我的安全摄像头变成了自动鸟类识别系统
chineseContent: 我使用 BirdNet-Go 将三个安全摄像头变成了自动鸟类识别系统。现在，我和妻子可以实时追踪到访我们院子的每种鸟类。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
